qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary affordable fashion jewellery; non-essential gift purchase easily forgone or deferred during economic downturns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (REJECT). Accessible and affordable fashion jewellery is entirely discretionary and easily forgone during economic downturns. Charms and silver jewelry lack essential need status, Lindy durability, or the inelastic pricing power of true ultra-luxury houses, while remaining heavily exposed to volatile precious metal input costs.
qualitative.evidence: World's largest jewellery maker by volume, operating high-volume manufacturing facilities in Thailand and Vietnam. Despite strong recent execution, the core product offering remains anchored in discretionary silver charm bracelets where silver represents ~30% of COGS. Operating in the accessible fashion jewellery tier exposes the business to middle-income consumer spending pullbacks and fashion fad risk.
